cpu.rerun_policy: Targeted corrections only; do not add repeated methods or claim an unchanged whole-suite rerun

source_layout_counting.file_selection: Git-tracked plus nonignored untracked ordinary .py files; no symlink following
source_layout_counting.historical_copies: No reference/baseline filename is excluded by name; only declared excluded directory parts. Inspect excluded paths for each snapshot.
source_layout_counting.physical_lines: len(bytes.splitlines()), including a final unterminated line
source_layout_counting.nonempty_lines: count(line.strip() != b"") over the same splitlines; comments and docstrings included
source_layout_counting.long_functions: FunctionDef and AsyncFunctionDef AST end_lineno-lineno+1 > 100; methods and nested functions included, decorators excluded, lambdas excluded
source_layout_counting.alternate_counts: Also record nonnested functions and decorator-inclusive spans; enclosing/nested function spans can overlap and are never summed as source line totals
